title: Economic Security and Technology
gist: Landing page for CSIS's Economic Security and Technology Department listing its topic areas, staff and recent analyses (drone war lessons, Texas semiconductors, interregional transmission, AI global governance); little substantive argument.

insights.claim: CSIS's Economic Security and Technology Department covers American innovation, cybersecurity, economic security, energy, technology, strategic capital, trade, global markets and quantum, aimed at sustaining US economic and technological advantages.
insights.speaker: CSIS
insights.so_what: Indicates the policy topics CSIS prioritizes; use as a pointer to recent research.

insights.claim: Recent department outputs include a report on moving the Texas semiconductor ecosystem to the next level, a commentary on interregional transmission as a hedge against uncertain large loads, and a report on AI global governance ahead of the U.S.-China Summit.
insights.speaker: CSIS
insights.so_what: Titles flag live policy themes: chip clusters, grid build-out for large loads, US-China AI talks.
